classification_notes.direction: Repo ±5bp neutral band: open -4.68bp is flat; close -98.97bp is down.
classification_notes.scenario: Repo metrics.py: strict >+50bp bull, <-50bp bear, otherwise base.
classification_notes.regime: Manual label from OHLC and dated reporting: open equaled daily high, index moved lower to -123.80bp and closed -98.97bp.
classification_notes.breadth: Official TWSE stock counts: 425 up vs 540 down = down. Breadth hit remains provisional because the repo lacks a frozen neutral-band formula.
classification_notes.brier: Mean squared multiclass Brier score per repo.

market_view.note: Bearish direction and large-electronics pressure were correct, but the open was flat rather than a large gap down, and the session became trend_down instead of range.

open_hypothesis.note: Forecast -55bp versus realized -4.68bp, flat under the repo ±5bp band. Gap magnitude was overestimated by 50.32bp.

intraday_hypothesis.note: The market opened at its daily high and moved lower. Realized trend_down contradicts the predicted weak range and holiday-related mean reversion.

close_hypothesis.note: Down direction was correct, but forecast -35bp/Base versus realized -98.97bp/Bear. Downside magnitude was underestimated by 63.97bp.

breadth_hypothesis.note: Official listed-stock breadth was negative, 425 advancers versus 540 decliners, while the forecast was flat. Cap-weight still underperformed equal-weight, but weakness broadened more than expected.

bull_script.note: The index never recovered the previous close; close return was far below +50bp.

base_script.note: The predicted opening gap did not occur, support was insufficient to keep the close in ±50bp, and the session trended down.

bear_script.note: Core heavyweight weakness, negative breadth and a close below -50bp aligned with Bear. VWAP and opening-range conjunctions remain unverified.

key_driver_evaluation.note: Night weakness predicted daily direction but substantially overstated the cash-open gap.
Electronics -1.07%, semiconductors -1.18%, TSMC -1.35% and other large electronics were weak.
Rates supplied plausible valuation pressure, but their exact causal contribution cannot be isolated.
Prior-day FX was context; its same-day causal effect was not isolated.
Equal-weight resilience relative to cap-weight persisted, but official breadth turned negative and financials fell 1.68%.
The holiday prior lowered trend probability, yet the session was trend_down and regular-session turnover remained about TWD 869.7bn.
The 13:30 TSMC revenue release was excluded from the prediction and is not treated as a pre-open driver.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Index did not recover the prior close and large electronics remained weak.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Index breached the night reference area and breadth was negative. Core electronics and financials weakened, while some non-electronics stayed positive. VWAP and intraday OTC conditions are unverified.

invalidation_condition_evaluation.note: Cap-weight fell more than MidCap/SmallCap and ex-financial/electronics was +0.15%, so the move was not uniform risk-off.

error_attribution.data: No formal pre-open V1 snapshot. Minute VWAP/opening-range, intraday breadth and TPEx breadth are absent.
error_attribution.inference: Correct bearish terminal direction was assigned too much to the opening gap and too little to intraday continuation.
error_attribution.weight: Holiday mean reversion and financial/non-electronic support were overweighted relative to large-cap, electronics and financial weakness.
error_attribution.magnitude: Opening downside overestimated by 50.32bp; closing downside underestimated by 63.97bp.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: Large-cap electronics and financials pulled the weighted index lower.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: Taiwan 50 -1.28%, electronics -1.07%, semiconductor -1.18%, financial -1.68%; reported TSMC -1.35%, MediaTek -3.00% and Quanta -2.84%.
actual_driver_attribution.causal_status: Strong descriptive alignment; exact point contribution unavailable.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: The selloff broadened but was not uniform.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: Official breadth 425 up versus 540 down; MidCap 100 -0.03%, SmallCap 300 -0.25%, ex-financial/electronics +0.15%, oil/gas +3.04%.

actual_driver_attribution.claim: Holiday positioning may have reduced risk appetite.
actual_driver_attribution.evidence: Dated reports cite pre-holiday caution, while turnover remained substantial.

source_conflicts.resolution: Use official TWSE stock column because news universes differ or are incompletely specified.

proposed_model_changes.proposal: Separate overnight direction from cash-open gap estimation. Aligned bearish signals may forecast intraday continuation even when the opening auction absorbs the gap.
Make the holiday effect conditional on opening-range acceptance, volume and breadth instead of automatically lowering trend probability.
Model breadth and cap-weight direction separately; do not assume prior-session financial strength persists.
Require generation and persistence before 09:00 for benchmark eligibility.

model_change_gate.reason: The timing error is useful for monitoring, but a late-generated sample cannot justify a rule change without repeated formal observations or walk-forward evidence.

limitations: No minute VWAP/opening-range series, intraday breadth path or TPEx breadth.
Calibration error and baseline lift require multiple eligible frozen days.
The 13:30 TSMC revenue release is post-cutoff and does not upgrade the forecast explanation.
